item.title: Transport v2.5.1.55
item.description:
Product: Transport v2.5.1.55
Company: Levylab
Release Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 18:24:57 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: VIs for scripting and performing transport measurments.

[Control Experiment]
- Control Experiment.vi
- provides a uniform way to record information about your sample & device
- record how the lockin is connected to the device
- configure the Krohn Hite amplifier
- set the base path for saving data
- configure peripheral instruments
- APIs for recording sample data, instrument status

[Transport]
Basic transport measurments:
- Lockin vs time (Lockin_time.vi)
- Lockin Sweep Mode (Lockin_sweep.vi)

[Transport Server]
Server used for scripting and performing asynchronous transport measurments.


Release Notes: [2.5.1.55]

Fixes #166: the Transport Server was unresponsive while an experiment ran.

- Experiments (Lockin_time, Lockin_sweep, THz_TimeDelay) now launch asynchronously
(call and forget), so the server keeps handling commands during a run.
`setRefreshTime` now takes effect immediately, the status text updates, and
`getStatus` reports `running` instead of `idle`.
- `startTransport` is refused with "Experiment already running" when an experiment
is running, instead of starting a second one.
- A refresh time that was never set is ignored, so an experiment keeps its own
configured refresh rate instead of being set to 0 ms.
- `stopTransport` on a running Lockin_sweep now stops it the same way its own stop
button does.
- The stopTransport button no longer closes the experiment's front panel.
- Stopping the server now stops a running experiment and waits for it (up to 5 s)
before releasing the notifiers.

**Note:** errors that occur inside an experiment VI are no longer returned to the
server, as a consequence of the asynchronous launch.
item.dc:creator: Levylab

item.title: Oxford-VRM v1.11.0.28
item.description:
Product: Oxford-VRM v1.11.0.28
Company: Levylab
Release Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 10:33:52 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: VIs for controlling the Oxford VRM PS that controls the CF900's 3D magnet

Release Notes: #17:
- reconnect automatically when the TCP connection to the IPS/ITC is lost
- detects VISA timeout, connection lost, I/O error, invalid session, resource not found and ID query errors
- reports the error once per outage, then retries in the background (5 s, doubling to a 60 s maximum)
- stops polling and database logging while disconnected
- aborts a running SetMagnet sequence when the connection is lost
- close hardware with a 1 s VISA timeout so the program exits quickly when the instrument is unreachable
- fix exit hanging when closing the program while disconnected
- add Handle Error override (Connection Error Reported?) and Is Connection Error.vi

- build with Instrument-Framework/1.15.13.55
- Handle GET / Handle SET now return error 5402 "parameter not supported" for unhandled parameters
- State History moved to Debug library (history depth 100 normal / 1000 debug)
- requires Debug >= 1.2.1.10, Logger-Error >= 1.2.3.10, Logger-PGSQL >= 1.3.1.16
- build with Remote-Control/1.4.2.21 and Remote-Control-ZMQ/1.3.7.30
- improved error handling for timeouts and dropped connections in Send Message
- default message timeout is now 500 ms (was 0)
- build with Logger-PGSQL/1.3.1.16 (#196 DB logger reconnects after losing its connection)
- package dependency: levylab_lib_levylab_instruments >=1.15.13.55
item.dc:creator: Levylab
